balanced_selection: Same completed indices in all 30 region/size/family strata; no selection by route, action or resource fit
scale_order_limitation: The primary series used lexical filenames, so 2048 m was interleaved before some smaller maps. Retain this protocol-order deviation; do not claim ascending-size timing or independent per-case process memory. Supplementary fresh-process memory controls use ascending sizes after the primary smaller maps have all completed.
interpretation: Counts are dependent planner episodes, not independent worlds, geological observations or estimates of a Mars occurrence probability. Region budgets and workloads differ. Policy pairs retain their actual, possibly different reached poses and consumed resources. Contextual-information attribution uses the separate matched-pose counterfactual, not these policy pairs. UNKNOWN is not proof of inaccessibility. No scalar scientific-interest score or discovery probability is constructed.
